channel.title: MyWriter
channel.description: Updates for MyWriter. Written by `make release`; don't edit by hand.

item.title: MyWriter 0.2.2
item.description:
• Hand cursor on everything clickable in the panels and dialogs; hover states on icon buttons and Lab result cards
  • Debug: simulate a disconnected ChatGPT account for testing the Connect AI card
  • Command style: Alternatives ⌥⌘A and AI alternatives ⌥⌘I, matching the other ⌥⌘ shortcuts
  • First-run polish: Connect AI card when ChatGPT isn't connected, hover states on toast buttons, ChatGPT first in providers, pointer cursor across Settings
  • Appcast: MyWriter 0.2.1

item.title: MyWriter 0.2.1
item.description:
• Disk image: arrow only, no hint text
  • Disk image with the standard drag-to-Applications layout: background, arrow, positioned icons
  • Keep the reading position when panels open or close; no re-wrap flicker
  • release: check for the update key and an up-to-date copy before building
  • MIT license; README for users first (install, privacy, feedback, development); Help → Send Feedback
  • release: push with an explicit remote and branch
  • Appcast: MyWriter 0.2.0
